B's crisp panel edges, detailed dial and small top ornament match the polished, slightly glossy real cards better than A's softer, blobbier finish.
B is more sharply modeled with cleaner highlights on the door bevel, closer to the vending machine, while A reads as a slightly soft clay toy.
B's detail and edge highlights sit closer to the real cards, while A is a little duller and more rubbery.
B has crisper door insets and a better-defined dial, like the real cards, while A's surfaces are softer and more matte.
